dsh-plugin-finance-data is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
